title: A soft voice, holding, rocking, or singing can help a child settle
summary: The milestone sheet says that staying steady and chatting softly, holding, rocking, or singing aids a child settle and lessens stress and fears.
body: The United States milestone sheet for 2-month page tells caregivers to practice staying steady when the child is distressed, by chatting softly, holding, rocking, or singing. The page says this will help the child settle and lessens stress and fears. The same family of actions appears again on later sheet age pages, but this card is the 2-month wording. It describes what the page says a steady caregiver can do. It does not say the crying will stop on a schedule.

sources.title: Milestones by 2 Months
sources.author: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
sources.note: US government public domain. Supports the tip to talk softly, hold, rock, or sing so the baby can calm down.
